text:
maria: Quick heads up — profiling from the 03:10 window shows a long-tail token latency increase (~95th-99th pct). Traces point at kernel-selector fallbacks + KV prefetch miss storms for long-seq routes. Also seeing a gap in kvcache.* metrics during the same minute.
kevin: ugh. did we deploy anything around then?
deploy-bot: deploy notice: runtime-core v2.1.7 rolled at 03:09:58 UTC by @kevin — change: kernel-selection heuristic tweak (fallback bias) and emitter buffer refactor.
javier: that matches. I ran a microprofile on canary and saw the selector prefer a slower CPU kernel when kv prefetch latency spikes. Combined with batching heuristics that shrink batches for long-seqs, token latency climbs.
rod: on infra side I see the statsd emitter queue hit high-water and OTel exporter returned 429s for ~45s starting 03:11:20. Likely dropped kvcache.* datapoints.
metrics-bot: alert: statsd->otlp error rate > 20% for 03:11-03:12 UTC. Missing metrics tag: kernel_variant for many kvcache series.
maria: OK, we need a plan: short-term mitigation + backfill for metrics + dashboard changes so this is visible per-route/token-phase. Suggestions?
kevin: short-term: roll runtime-core back to v2.1.6 (revert fallback bias) and temporarily increase StatsD UDP buffer and emitter throughput. That should reduce new missing metrics and reduce misrouting to CPU kernels.
javier: agree. Also flip on aggressive KV prefix caching for the affected routes to reduce prefetch miss rate while we investigate root cause.
rod: I'll nudge the metrics ingestion team to accept a one-off higher write QPS window and hold small OTLP bursts. For backfill, we can replay statsd logs for the 03:10–03:15 window from node logs if they exist.
maria: good. For the backfill replay, what's the concrete command?
javier: something like:
```
cat /var/log/runtime/statsd-*.log | grep kvcache | python tools/statsd_replay.py --start 2026-03-12T03:10:00Z --end 2026-03-12T03:15:00Z --target otlp://metrics-collector:4317
```
kevin: + add a transform to attach `kernel_variant` tag when missing, derived from runtime traces (we can join on request_id). We'll need to annotate replayed points with that tag for dashboard continuity.
rod: I'll coordinate retention and ingestion with ingestion@ for the replay window. We should mark it as backfill and keep original timestamps.
maria: dashboard changes: we need a per-route token-latency waterfall that shows kernel_variant, kvcache.hit, prefetch.lat ms, batching_size. Also a KPI card for percent of tokens served from KV prefix cache.
kevin: I'll open a quick dashboard PR with a new panel (token-latency-breakdown) and add an explanation note for how to interpret kernel tags vs batch size.
javier: also recommend adding a health metric: `kvcache.prefetch_queue_len` and alert if prefetch misses/sec spikes > 5x baseline.
rod: action items:
- roll runtime-core -> v2.1.6 immediately (rod + kevin)
- bump statsd emitter buffers for 30m window (rod)
- deploy KV prefix caching toggle for affected routes (javier)
- schedule statsd log replay backfill and tag enrichment (maria + rod + kevin)
- update dashboard: token waterfall + per-route KPI (kevin)
- postmortem if backfill shows persistent regression (maria)
maria: timeline?
kevin: revert deploy in next 5m, emitter bump in 10m, KV toggle in 20m, backfill job to run in 60-90m pending ingestion agreement.
javier: I'll capture profiling snippets and a small repro harness (we should be able to simulate kernel selector behavior with a synthetic long-seq workload).
rod: noted. I'll open a ticket with the ingestion team and request temporary elevated throughput for the backfill.
maria: thanks all. tagging follow-ups into the incident channel and will keep this thread updated. :thumbsup:
